public_definitions: The task is to review the 2017 transplant comparison dashboard and choose the follow-up route that best fits the service-line comparison for this reporting year.
The dashboard is the evidence source for the 2017 transplant service-line routing decision.

The primary field is '2017 transplant comparison route' with three options: 'Route the 2017 kidney transplant program to higher-volume follow-up', 'Route the 2017 transplant comparison to matched-volume review', and 'Send the 2017 transplant comparison to background service-line review'.
